Author: Gerry of Ravine
Name: ClickToMove
Description: Click where you wanna go! Hold Shift and left-click the world to walk there. Uses vnavmesh pathfinding when available, straight line fallback otherwise. Movement idea adapted from Jaksuhn ffxiv-bundleoftweaks (BSD-3-Clause). Requires vnavmesh for pathfinding: https://puni.sh/api/repository/veyn
